newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 259,500 metric tons (MT) fell 56 percent from the previous week and 64 percent from the 4-week average.
Increases reported for Japan (99,300 MT), the Philippines (40,000 MT), Nigeria (31,200 MT), and Morocco (20,100 MT) were partially offset by decreases for unknown destinations (36,400 MT).

Exports of 661,100 MT were 9 percent more than the prior week and two-fifths more than the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Egypt (210,900 MT), Sri Lanka (50,400 MT), Lebanon (48,200 MT), Nigeria (45,000 MT), Japan (41,200 MT), and South Korea (40,200 MT).
